name: Feeds Log
description: Logs the records a Feeds import did not import, for review/debugging.
project_description:
This module is obsolete now that [#2907721] has been merged into Feeds. This functionality is now part of Feeds module !

 Feeds Log provides list of unimported items in feeds depends on validation. List contains Label, Log Time, Message(fields name along with reason)

 Module Dependency 

 
 Feeds 
 
 Installation 

 
 Before installing this module, you have to apply the following patch. This patch used to invoke hook for feeds log.

 The patch differs per version (different hook names):

 
 For 8.x-1.x: https://www.drupal.org/files/issues/2907721.patch 
 For 2.x: https://www.drupal.org/files/issues/2022-01-21/feeds_feed_log2.x_hooks-… 
 
 Install this module one new tab will get add in feeds view i.e Unimported items.
